<p style="font-size:19px;color:#444;max-width:640px;line-height:1.5">Full marketing management for a 5-branch flowers and gifts brand, from identity and catalog to sales.</p>

</div><div class="tag">3 · Case study (one per brand)</div><div class="frame" id="case">
<div class="p">
<div class="sec" style="padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:28px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px">
<b class="h" style="font-size:20px">Hamdy Moustafa</b>
<div style="display:flex;gap:28px;font-size:15px"><a href="#industries">Industries</a><a href="#services">Services</a><a href="#industry">Case Studies</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></div>
</div>
<div class="sec" style="padding-top:24px">
<a href="#industry" style="font-size:15px">← Gifts &amp; Flowers</a>
<div class="lbl" style="margin-top:24px">Case study · Gifts &amp; Flowers</div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin:12px 0 16px;flex-wrap:wrap"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Flowers Basket logo" style="width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(10,31,68,.06),0 8px 22px rgba(10,31,68,.12)"><h1 class="h" style="font-size:56px;margin:0">Flowers Basket</h1></div>
<p style="font-size:22px;color:#12408F;max-width:720px;line-height:1.4;margin:0">Cost per order cut from about EGP 10K to about EGP 670, with EGP 85K in sales in the first month. It now sells EGP 85K to 100K every month on about EGP 20K–22K of ad spend.</p>
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));margin-top:32px">
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">BRAND</div><div>Flowers &amp; gifts brand, 5 branches, since 1980</div></div>
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">MY ROLE</div><div>Marketing management, A to Z</div></div>
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">PLATFORMS</div><div>Meta, WhatsApp Business, Website</div></div>
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">DURATION</div><div>Ongoing, 3 months so far</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sec" style="padding-top:16px">
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:40px">
<div><div class="lbl">Where it started</div><p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#333">Roughly EGP 40–50K of ad spend had produced only about 4 orders in a month. The brand had no consistent identity, the website customer journey was slow and overcomplicated, and WhatsApp Business was empty with no product catalog.</p></div>
<div><div class="lbl">What I did</div><p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#333">I started by sitting with the owner to understand the brand story, positioning and pricing, then rebuilt the foundations before spending on ads.<br><br><b>Identity:</b> reworked about 300 product images into one consistent style.<br><b>WhatsApp:</b> built a product catalog so customers can browse and order in chat.<br><b>Website:</b> products first instead of hashtags, Arabic support, price filtering by customer need.<br><b>Campaigns:</b> tested audiences and welcome messages.<br><b>Content:</b> videos telling the brand story and product value.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sec" style="padding-top:16px">
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));margin-bottom:24px"><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">EGP 85K</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Sales in the first month</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">4.25x</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">ROAS in the first month</div></div></div>
<div class="lbl" style="margin-bottom:16px">Results · Before → After</div>
<div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow-x:auto"><table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:18px;min-width:560px">
<tr style="background:#0A1F44;color:#fff;text-align:left"><th style="padding:16px 24px">Metric</th><th style="padding:16px 24px">Before</th><th style="padding:16px 24px">After</th><th style="padding:16px 24px">Change</th></tr>
<tr><td style="padding:16px 24px">Ad spend</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">~EGP 40–50K</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">EGP 20K</td><td style="padding:16px 24px;color:#0E8A52;font-weight:500">−50% to −60%</td></tr>
<tr style="background:#F1F6F6"><td style="padding:16px 24px">Orders</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">~4</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">~30</td><td style="padding:16px 24px;color:#0E8A52;font-weight:500">~7x</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding:16px 24px">Cost per order</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">~EGP 10–12.5K</td><td style="padding:16px 24px">~EGP 670</td><td style="padding:16px 24px;color:#0E8A52;font-weight:500">−93% to −95%</td></tr>
</table></div>
<p class="note">Before figures are owner-reported and approximate, covering the earlier advertising period. After figures cover the first month of the engagement.</p>
<div class="lbl" style="margin:32px 0 16px">Where it is now · Ongoing</div>
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));margin-bottom:12px"><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">EGP 85K–100K</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Monthly sales in ordinary months</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">EGP 20K–22K</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Monthly ad budget</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">~4x–5x</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Return on ad spend (sales ÷ ad spend)</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">EGP 220K</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Best month so far (sales)</div></div><div class="card" style="padding:22px"><div class="h" style="font-size:40px;color:#0E8A52">EGP 55K</div><div style="font-weight:500;margin-top:6px">Total ad spend over about 2.5 months</div></div></div>
<p class="note">Monthly figures are approximate and show a range across ordinary months, with no seasonal peak. All of it comes from ad spend, and sales are closed in WhatsApp conversations that start from the ads, not through checkout on the website. After 3 months of working together, the brand runs steadily on the same monthly budget.</p><p class="note">The EGP 220K month is reported by the client.</p>

</div>

<p style="font-size:22px;color:#12408F;max-width:760px;line-height:1.4;margin:0">~EGP 2.2M in sales on ~EGP 140K of ad spend during Black Friday month (~15.5x ROAS).</p>
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));margin-top:32px">
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">BRAND</div><div>Tech retailer: laptops, PCs, monitors</div></div>
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">MY ROLE</div><div>Media Buyer</div></div>

<div class="sec" style="padding-top:16px">

<div><div class="lbl">Where it started</div><p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#333">Going into Black Friday, customers had to go through several steps on the website before they could complete a purchase, which made buying harder than it needed to be.</p></div>
<div><div class="lbl">What I did</div><p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:#333">I joined as media buyer for the Black Friday month and ran many offers and promotions across a full-funnel Meta structure: awareness, engagement, traffic, and sales through both WhatsApp conversations and website purchases. In parallel, I worked on website changes to cut down the steps customers needed to complete an order.</p></div>
</div>
</div>

<p style="font-size:22px;color:#12408F;max-width:760px;line-height:1.4;margin:0">EGP 120.7K in sales in 6 days (+317%) on EGP 6.5K of ad spend.</p>
<div class="grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));margin-top:32px">
<div class="card" style="padding:20px"><div style="color:#777;font-size:13px">BRAND</div><div>Online store on Shopify</div></div>

var top=document.createElement('button');top.id='totop';top.setAttribute('aria-label','Back to top');top.innerHTML='&#8593;';document.body.appendChild(top);
top.onclick=function(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})};
var lb=document.createElement('div');lb.id='lb';lb.innerHTML='<img alt="">';document.body.appendChild(lb);
lb.onclick=function(){lb.classList.remove('on')};
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')lb.classList.remove('on')});
/* one-time prep */
document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#industry"]').forEach(function(a){if(a.textContent.trim()==='Case Studies')a.setAttribute('href','#industries')});
frames.forEach(function(f){
  var p=f.querySelector('.p'),first=p&&p.firstElementChild;
  if(first&&first.classList.contains('sec')){var w=document.createElement('div');w.className='navbar';p.insertBefore(w,first);w.appendChild(first);
    var b=first.querySelector('b.h');if(b)b.onclick=function(){location.hash='home'}}
});
var hp=document.querySelector('#home .p');if(hp){var o=document.createElement('div');o.className='orbs';o.innerHTML='<i></i><i></i><i></i>';hp.insertBefore(o,hp.firstChild)}
document.querySelectorAll('h1.h').forEach(function(h){
  var words=h.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/);h.setAttribute('aria-label',h.textContent.trim());h.textContent='';
  words.forEach(function(w,i){var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='w';s.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');s.innerHTML='<span style="--i:'+i+'"></span>';s.firstChild.textContent=w;h.appendChild(s);if(i<words.length-1)h.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '))});
});
document.querySelectorAll('.shot').forEach(function(im){im.addEventListener('click',function(){lb.firstChild.src=im.src;lb.classList.add('on')})});
document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(function(c){
  if(c.querySelector('a[href^="#"]')){c.classList.add('hov');
    if(!reduce&&matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches){
      c.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){if(!c.classList.contains('done'))return;var r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;c.style.transform='perspective(900px) rotateX('+(-y*5)+'deg) rotateY('+(x*6)+'deg) translateY(-4px)'});
      c.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){c.style.transform=''});
    }}
});
/* counters */
function prepCount(el){var t=el.textContent.trim(),m=t.match(/^(\D*?)(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)(\D*)$/);if(!m||!/^\d/.test(m[2]))return;el.dataset.pre=m[1];el.dataset.num=m[2];el.dataset.suf=m[3];el.dataset.full=t}
function runCount(el){
  if(!el.dataset.num||reduce){return}
  var raw=el.dataset.num,dec=(raw.split('.')[1]||'').length,comma=raw.indexOf(',')>-1,target=parseFloat(raw.replace(/,/g,'')),t0=null;
  function fmt(v){var s=v.toFixed(dec);if(comma){var p=s.split('.');p[0]=p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',');s=p.join('.')}return s}
  function step(ts){if(!t0)t0=ts;var k=Math.min((ts-t0)/1300,1),e=1-Math.pow(1-k,4);el.textContent=el.dataset.pre+fmt(target*e)+el.dataset.suf;if(k<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else el.textContent=el.dataset.full}
  requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
/* reveal */
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(!e.isIntersecting)return;var el=e.target;io.unobserve(el);el.classList.add('in');
  var d=parseInt((el.style.getPropertyValue('--d')||'0'),10)||0;setTimeout(function(){el.classList.add('done')},950+d);
  if(el.dataset.num)runCount(el)})},{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
var SEL='.lbl,.sec>p,.sec>a,.note,.shot,h1.h,h2.h,.card,.grid>img,.sec>div>.card,.cf,table';
function prepare(fr){
  var seen=[];
  fr.querySelectorAll(SEL).forEach(function(el){
    if(el.classList.contains('rv')||el.closest('.navbar'))return;
    if(el.tagName==='TABLE')return;
    el.classList.add('rv');if(el.tagName==='H1')el.classList.add('rvh');
    var par=el.parentElement,idx=0;
    if(par&&(par.classList.contains('grid'))){idx=[].indexOf.call(par.children,el)}
    el.style.setProperty('--d',Math.min(idx,8)*80+'ms');
    var n=el.matches('.card')?el.querySelector('.h[style*="#0E8A52"]'):null;if(n)prepCount(n);
    if(n&&n.dataset.num){el.dataset.num='';} 
    el._cn=n;
  });
  fr.querySelectorAll('.rv:not(.in)').forEach(function(el){
    if(el._cn&&el._cn.dataset.num){var c=el._cn;var o=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){if(es[0].isIntersecting){o.disconnect();c.textContent=c.dataset.pre+'0'+c.dataset.suf;runCount(c)}},{threshold:.4});if(!reduce)o.observe(el)}
    io.observe(el);
  });
}
/* router */
function route(){
  var id=decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1))||'home',el=document.getElementById(id)||document.getElementById('home');
  var fr=el.classList.contains('frame')?el:el.closest('.frame')||document.getElementById('home');
  var changed=fr!==cur;
  if(changed){frames.forEach(function(f){f.classList.toggle('active',f===fr)});cur=fr;window.scrollTo(0,0);prepare(fr)}
  if(el!==fr)setTimeout(function(){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:changed||reduce?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'})},changed?60:0);
  else if(!changed)window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',route);
function onScroll(){var s=window.scrollY||document.documentElement.scrollTop,h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;prog.style.transform='scaleX('+(h>0?s/h:0)+')';top.classList.toggle('show',s>700);document.querySelectorAll('.frame.active .navbar').forEach(function(n){n.classList.toggle('stuck',s>8)})}
window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});
route();onScroll();
/* contact form */
var form=document.getElementById('cf');
if(form){form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();
  var g=function(n){return(form.elements[n].value||'').trim()},err=form.querySelector('.err');
  if(!g('name')||!g('message')||(!g('email')&&!g('phone'))){err.textContent='Please add your name, a message, and an email or phone number.';return}
  if(g('email')&&!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(g('email'))){err.textContent='That email address does not look right.';return}
  err.textContent='';
  var msg='Hi Hamdy, I am '+g('name')+'.\n'+(g('service')?'Service: '+g('service')+'\n':'')+g('message')+'\n\n'+(g('email')?'Email: '+g('email')+'\n':'')+(g('phone')?'Phone: '+g('phone'):'');
  var url='https://wa.me/201503495034?text='+encodeURIComponent(msg);
  var ok=document.getElementById('cf-ok');ok.querySelector('a').href=url;ok.querySelector('.nm').textContent=g('name');
  form.style.display='none';ok.style.display='block';
  try{window.open(url,'_blank')}catch(x){}
})}
})();

var KEYS={};Object.keys(D.eg).concat(Object.keys(D.gu)).forEach(function(k){KEYS[k]=1});
var PH={'Your name':{eg:'اسمك',gu:'اسمك'},'Email':{eg:'الإيميل',gu:'البريد الإلكتروني'},'Phone / WhatsApp':{eg:'التليفون / واتساب',gu:'الجوال / واتساب'},'Tell me about your brand and goals':{eg:'احكيلي عن براندك وأهدافك',gu:'حدّثني عن علامتك وأهدافك'}};
var ER={'Please add your name, a message, and an email or phone number.':{eg:'من فضلك اكتب اسمك ورسالتك وإيميل أو رقم تليفون.',gu:'فضلاً اكتب اسمك ورسالتك وبريدك الإلكتروني أو رقم جوالك.'},'That email address does not look right.':{eg:'الإيميل ده شكله مش صح.',gu:'البريد الإلكتروني غير صحيح.'}};
var AUD={eg:'أهلاً حمدي، عايز أوديت تسويق مجاني لبراندي.',gu:'هلا حمدي، أبغى تدقيقاً تسويقياً مجانياً لعلامتي.'};
var TITLE=document.title,cur='en';
function nodes(){var w=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null),n,l=[];while(n=w.nextNode()){var p=n.parentNode.nodeName;if(p!=='SCRIPT'&&p!=='STYLE')l.push(n)}return l}
function setLang(l){
  cur=l;var map=D[l];
  nodes().forEach(function(n){
    var t=n.nodeValue.trim();
    if(n._o===undefined){if(!t||!KEYS[t])return;n._o=n.nodeValue;n._t=t}
    if(!map){n.nodeValue=n._o;return}
    var tr=map[n._t];
    if(tr!==undefined){var m=n._o.match(/^(\s*)/)[1],e=n._o.match(/(\s*)$/)[1];n.nodeValue=m+tr+e}else n.nodeValue=n._o;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label]').forEach(function(h){
    if(!h.querySelector(':scope > .w')&&h._ho===undefined)return;
    if(h._ho===undefined){h._ho=h.innerHTML;h._k=h.getAttribute('aria-label')}
    var tr=map&&map[h._k];
    if(tr){h.textContent=tr;h.classList.remove('ltr')}
    else{h.innerHTML=h._ho;h.classList.toggle('ltr',!!map)}
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder],textarea[placeholder]').forEach(function(el){
    if(el._p===undefined)el._p=el.getAttribute('placeholder');
    var r=PH[el._p];el.setAttribute('placeholder',(r&&map)?r[l]:el._p)});
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="wa.me"][href*="text="]').forEach(function(a){
    if(a._h===undefined)a._h=a.getAttribute('href');
    a.setAttribute('href',map?'https://wa.me/201503495034?text='+encodeURIComponent(AUD[l]):a._h)});
  document.title=(map&&map[TITLE])||TITLE;
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang',l==='en'?'en':'ar');
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('dir',l==='en'?'ltr':'rtl');
  document.querySelectorAll('.lsw button').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('on',b.getAttribute('data-l')===l)});
  try{localStorage.setItem('lang',l)}catch(e){}
}
var sw='<span class="lsw"><button type="button" data-l="en">EN</button><button type="button" data-l="eg">مصري</button><button type="button" data-l="gu">خليجي</button></span>';
document.querySelectorAll('.frame').forEach(function(f){
  var a=f.querySelector('a[href="#contact"]');if(!a)return;
  var bar=a.parentNode.parentNode;bar.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',sw)});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var b=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.lsw button');if(b){setLang(b.getAttribute('data-l'))}});
document.querySelectorAll('.err').forEach(function(el){
  new MutationObserver(function(){var t=el.textContent;if(!t)return;var r=ER[t];if(r&&cur!=='en')el.textContent=r[cur]}).observe(el,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true})});
var q=(location.search.match(/[?&]lang=(en|eg|gu)/)||[])[1],s='';
try{s=localStorage.getItem('lang')||''}catch(e){}
var init=q||s;if(init==='eg'||init==='gu')setLang(init);else setLang('en');
})();
</script></body></html>
